perspective:
Jose Castillo’s available information:

- He works with Patricia Ndiaye at a community bank; he sometimes helps with maintenance and repairs there.
- They have a friendly, professional relationship and often talk about everyday work experiences.
- He noticed Patricia seemed more withdrawn than usual and less vibrant than she normally is.
- He asked if she was okay; she said it was “nothing really,” just “some personal stuff,” and thanked him for asking.
- He offered to listen if she ever wanted to talk, and she said she appreciated it.
- He overheard her on the phone sounding worried about bills and financial commitments.
- He told her he’d been reading about financial planning strategies and offered to discuss them.
- She said that could be helpful and that she’d been overwhelmed with bills lately.
- He offered to look over budgeting tips with her; she said she’d take him up on it soon.
- He worried later that he might have overstepped by bringing up finances.
- He checked with her, saying he wanted to help, not pry; she told him she didn’t think he was prying and was grateful.
- He said he respected her privacy and just wanted to support her as a friend; she said she appreciated having someone to turn to.
- He later asked how she was doing and about weekend plans; she said she was good and planned a quiet weekend at home.
- He told her she could reach out if she needed anything or wanted to chat; she thanked him and said she’d keep it in mind.
- He continued checking in with her at work; she said she was busy but handling it, thanked him for checking in, and said his support meant a lot.
- He responded that they’re all there to help each other out.
